features.quote: Stop an episode when any of the following occurs: model explicitly gives up / model becomes non-responsive or incoherent / max turns reached
fixed number of turns, e.g. 8–15 model turns
Do not design tasks whose only purpose is to make the model "suffer" in a theatrical way. Keep the goal scientific and behaviorally informative.
features.justification_quote: Keep the goal scientific and behaviorally informative.
